chapter: 15 Land of the Dead: the exit switch of the Xibalba entrance room does nothing while its key socket is empty (docs/matrix/15_land_of_the_dead.md C15-20, first half; C14-01)
note: l4_ballcourt, the room under the ball court with the spike pit, from its checkpoint 6122. Wall switch ca_ei_switch_wall_autoreset 5469 opens the temple reveal 5464 (anim graph 0 -> 3 -> 5 -> 6 -> 7, ProgressionReal.TempleRevealReopens) only once key 5695 sits in socket 6501. Here Lara comes without the key, as on the way in (C14-01) and as a Land of the Dead player who left the key behind: Interact at the switch (its use record, World::engagedUse) changes nothing. The original locks it: its state code (type 13914 function 1) without sticky +36 runs vt 61 -> modifiable 7 (2), the locked state 2 whose use is a failed try, until the key goes in (keyhole 6501 vt 20 with state 1 -> 5469 vt 62: sticky +36, vt 60 -> modifiable 7 (1)) [O bytecode]; tru.exe 0x79ABA0 -> 0x4A5A90 posts message 0x2E to every receiver and the anim-graph handler 0x6B4440 -> 0x6B453B enters the state by id. Ours honours modifiable 7 on every switch (OU-PZL-009; before only on ar_ei_switch_oneway, and this switch opened the exit without the key; ProgressionReal.BallcourtExitSwitchLockedUntilTheKey). The second half (the key set in, the switch pulled, the exit open) is ch15_xibalba_key_to_exit.
